name: Common
description: The common language, derived from English and acts as the universal trade language throughout the galaxy. Most people speak it.

name: High Gothic
description: The old language. Derived from Latin, mostly used by scholars, priests, and politicians.

name: Vrang
description: The most common dialect of the Vargr language.

name: Ancient
description: The language of the ancients, obscure and never spoken anywhere across the known galaxy. Only known by xenoarcheologists, and tomb raiders.
